newsitem.title: UK: UK rate rise will fuel sterling rally - BCC.
newsitem.headline: UK rate rise will fuel sterling rally - BCC.

text.p: If the British government increases interest rates this would give a further boost to the already strong pound and have serious consequences for the economy, the British Chambers of Commerce said on Thursday.

Asked if a rate rise would make the pound go higher and stay there, BCC presiden David Richardson said: "Yes - you saw what happened after the last rate rise." "Fiscal tightening would be much less damaging to the economy than a rate rise," he told reporters.
There is speculation that whichever party wins the May 1 election, UK rates will have to rise from their current official level of 6.0 percent.
